note: Attacker-controlled PROXY v2 header (16 bytes) is cast to the proxy_header_v2 struct. The signature starts with \r\n\r\n so read_request_finalizer returns DONE and parsing proceeds.
size (56) is compared against sizeof(*hdr) (56). Since 56 > 56 is false, the bounds check passes even though the actual received buffer is only 16 bytes.
cmd_ver is 0x21 (PROXY), so the PROXY branch is taken.
fam is 0x11 (TCP4), so the TCP4 branch is taken and address fields are read.
buffer advances by size (56) past the 16-byte received input, pointing beyond the actual data.
adjusted_size = value + len - buffer = 16 - 56, which underflows to a huge size_t value because buffer advanced past the end of the received data.
memmem is called with a huge adjusted_size, causing an out-of-bounds read past the end of the buffer (buffer overflow).
